scope.included_project_files: Every Python file under src/tse_session_ranker plus the four registered transitive research dependencies listed in project_files.
scope.cycle_break_contract: This lock contains transitive implementation dependencies only. It deliberately excludes itself, the v1.8 protocol, hypothesis, runner, independent audit, tests, calendar, activation payload, and activation receipt. The activation payload binds the exact runtime-lock file bytes and directly binds the v1.8 protocol, hypothesis, runner, audit, tests, and calendar. The runner and audit may therefore pin the runtime-lock file SHA-256 without making their own bytes an input to that digest.

project_file_set_hash_rule: project_files is strictly path-sorted with unique repository-relative POSIX paths and ordinary exact-file SHA-256 digests. project_file_set_sha256 is project-canonical JSON SHA-256 of the project_files array.

platform.timezone_rule: All protocol dates and aware timestamps explicitly use zoneinfo.ZoneInfo('Asia/Tokyo') backed by the registered zoneinfo bytes. The process TZ environment, time.tzname, host default zone, and locale are not evidence and need not equal Asia/Tokyo; naive host-local parsing is forbidden.

python.stdlib_tree_hash_rule: Resolve sysconfig.get_paths()['stdlib']; recursively enumerate regular files; exclude any path containing site-packages, dist-packages, or __pycache__ and any .pyc; reject symlinks; hash exact bytes; sort {path,sha256} objects by stdlib-relative POSIX path; stdlib_file_count is the array length and stdlib_tree_sha256 is its project-canonical JSON SHA-256.

ca_trust.context_rule: Before every GitHub HTTPS request require SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR absent from os.environ; require cafile_path to be the exact registered absolute resolved regular non-symlink path with matching basename, size, and ordinary exact-byte SHA-256; then construct the only permitted client context as ssl.create_default_context(cafile=cafile_path) with no capath or cadata. Calling create_default_context without this explicit cafile, using OpenSSL default paths, scanning a CA directory, accepting caller trust input, disabling hostname or certificate verification, or mutating the context trust store is forbidden.

ssl.binding_rule: _ssl is a CPython built-in in this runtime, so there is no separately loaded extension file and its implementation bytes are transitively bound by executable_sha256. Require the same built-in origin, exact ssl.OPENSSL_VERSION and tuple, JSON null for all extension and dynamic-library hash fields, and the exact ca_trust schema/file/environment/context contract. No external linkage probe, including ldd, is an operational dependency or permitted validation input; pdftotext and Git are the only registered subprocess executables.

startup_and_module_closure.startup_file_set_hash_rule: At interpreter startup enumerate every *.pth entry directly under each exact site_packages_roots directory, reject a missing root, symlink, non-regular file, extra file, or duplicate, and build the path-sorted startup_files array with exact absolute resolved path, basename, owning registered distribution name, byte size, and ordinary exact-byte SHA-256. startup_file_set_sha256 is project-canonical JSON SHA-256 of that array. No .pth may be ignored because it executes before operational validation.
startup_and_module_closure.generated_alias_rule: six.moves is the sole registered distribution-generated originless alias. Require its exact module name, null __file__, null spec.origin, empty spec.submodule_search_locations list, and loader class module/qualname six._SixMetaPathImporter; require the loader provider to be the exact registered six distribution's absolute regular non-symlink six.py with matching SHA and tree membership. Object repr, identity, and memory address are ignored. No six.moves submodule, wildcard, second alias, different loader, null loader, nonempty search location, or unregistered provider is implied or allowed.
startup_and_module_closure.loaded_module_origin_rule: After the registered runtime imports and before every canonical phase, inspect every live sys.modules entry. A module origin may be only built-in/frozen; an exact hashed stdlib-tree file outside site-packages/dist-packages; an exact project_files entry; one of the two direct activation project module paths whose bytes are separately preregistration/payload-bound to avoid a lock cycle; or an exact retained file and SHA in one of runtime.distributions. A module with null spec but a non-null __file__ is allowed only when that exact file is already in one of those hashed authorities (covering generated Cython aliases). A module with null spec and no file is allowed only when its name is an exact originless_runtime_module_names member generated by the already-hashed stdlib/native modules, or when it is exactly six.moves and every generated_alias_modules field and generated_alias_rule check passes. __main__ and __mp_main__ are allowed only when their shared __file__ is exactly the currently executing registered direct activation runner or audit path and those bytes pass their separate protocol/payload binding. A namespace package with null origin is allowed only when every search location is an absolute resolved non-symlink directory within one registered project or distribution authority and is an ancestor of at least one exact hashed file in that same authority. Any other origin, unowned site-package file, zip/egg/dynamic-memory loader, changed byte, unexpected missing spec, customize module, new startup .pth, alias, or loader resolving outside registered trees aborts. Re-run this closure check after parser, network, fit, score, and terminal imports so a later lazy import cannot escape the lock.
startup_and_module_closure.existing_cli_rule: The existing python research/... operational CLI remains valid; isolated mode is not newly required. Reproducibility instead requires the exact sole startup .pth and startup module above, no sitecustomize/usercustomize, the absent user-site directory, PYTHONHOME, PYTHONPATH, PYTHONNOUSERSITE, PYTHONSAFEPATH, PYTHONUSERBASE, and SETUPTOOLS_USE_DISTUTILS absence, and exhaustive live-module origin validation. A user-site, startup-hook, or .pth-control environment appearance aborts rather than being silently ignored.

runtime.locked_requirements_hash_rule: SHA-256 of the locked_requirements strings in their registered sorted order, joined by LF and terminated by one LF.
runtime.distribution_tree_hash_rule: For each named importlib.metadata distribution, enumerate distribution.files; exclude paths ending .pyc or containing an __pycache__ component; retain existing regular files only; compute each exact file SHA-256; sort objects {path,sha256} by distribution-relative POSIX path; file_count is the array length and tree_sha256 is its project-canonical JSON SHA-256. Any missing, extra, symlinked, or byte-different retained file fails the lock.
runtime.native_threadpool_rule: Import NumPy, SciPy, and scikit-learn before calling threadpoolctl.threadpool_info. Sort observed libraries by user_api, internal_api, prefix, and library_file_name; require exact backend metadata, resolved library basename, and ordinary library-byte SHA-256. The recorded startup num_threads values are acquisition provenance only and are not runtime-equality gates because host CPU capacity may differ. Environment variables must equal thread_environment before any numeric fit or score.

numeric_execution_contract.rule: Every Ridge fit, numeric-bundle reconstruction, score generation, and terminal clean-room numeric replay runs inside threadpoolctl.threadpool_limits(limits=1). Inside that context every registered BLAS and OpenMP library must report num_threads exactly 1; falling back to the startup value, an unregistered backend, or an uncontrolled parallel fit is an integrity failure.

elf_closure.object_path_rule: root_objects and shared_objects are strictly absolute-path sorted and path-unique. Every path is the registered resolved path to a regular non-symlink ELF file; basename equals Path(path).name and sha256 is ordinary exact-byte SHA-256. Roles are sorted unique. Counts and project-canonical array hashes must match.
elf_closure.acquisition_rule: Offline preregistration inspection started the ordinary registered Python CLI, captured every executed site-packages .pth and startup module before validation, imported the runner and independent audit dependency paths plus locked urllib/SSL and numerical stack, mapped all 1,521 live modules after the full registered lazy-import probe to the stdlib/project/eleven distribution trees or the one exact six.moves generated-alias exception, exercised the fixed SimpleImputer(add_indicator=True)-StandardScaler-Ridge(alpha=1.0) pipeline plus bootstrap primitives inside threadpool_limits(1), collected all loaded stdlib/distribution ELF extension roots including both charset-normalizer native modules and numeric libraries, added exact Python/pdftotext/Git executables, fixed the single explicit GitHub HTTPS CA file, and resolved each root recursive dependency closure. Offline inspection tooling is not part of operational validation.
elf_closure.runtime_validation_rule: Operational runner and audit never invoke ldd, readelf, objdump, or another linkage inspector. Before any canonical phase they directly validate runtime.startup_and_module_closure, enumerate and hash the exact startup .pth/module origins and all eleven distribution trees, apply the narrow exact six.moves generated-alias rule, reject every other live module origin outside the registered stdlib/project/distribution authorities, require exact ELF field sets/order/counts/set hashes, hash every registered absolute root/shared-object path and loader/cache, require exact basenames and no symlink, require every loader_environment name including SSL_CERT_FILE and SSL_CERT_DIR absent, and independently validate runtime.python.ssl.ca_trust. The live-module check repeats after lazy-importing operations. Exact startup code, module origins/trees, roots, recursive closure bytes, loader/cache bytes, explicit CA bytes, and a clean critical environment are jointly the runtime authority; any drift aborts.
elf_closure.external_process_rule: Invoke only the registered absolute pdftotext or Git executable with shell=false and an environment constructed exactly from common_exact plus its exact_extra map; inherit_parent_environment is false. No PATH lookup, loader variable, token, HOME, locale default, or other parent variable reaches the child.

pdftotext.verification_rule: Use only executable_path without PATH lookup or shell; require the exact absolute resolved regular non-symlink path, basename, executable-byte SHA-256, and matching elf_closure root. Run pdftotext -v under elf_closure.external_process_environment common_exact plus pdftotext_exact_extra and no inherited environment; require version 24.02.0 and the SHA-256 of exact stderr bytes including final LF.

git.verification_rule: Use only executable_path without PATH lookup or shell; require the exact absolute resolved regular non-symlink path, basename, executable-byte SHA-256, and matching elf_closure root. Run --version and all later local plumbing with shell=false under exactly elf_closure.external_process_environment common_exact plus git_exact_extra and no inherited environment. Require version 2.51.1, empty stderr, and SHA-256 of exact stdout bytes b'git version 2.51.1\n'.

runtime_lock_self_hash_rule: runtime_lock_self_sha256 is SHA-256 of project-canonical JSON with only runtime_lock_self_sha256 omitted.
